properties.name: A member store can record an export path into its hub on main, and the hub skill does not say so
properties.statement:
Field log entry 2026-10-09 (hxm_program hub, VS Code 1.140, reflow2 0.80.0): every write to a member store printed "no export was kept current". The member's export lives in the hub repo (designs/<member>/design.json) and is written by hand. The reporter: same root as the 2026-10-06 entry (no recorded export target per store).

MEASURED 2026-10-09 ON MAIN: a member folder holding only `.reflow2.toml` with `[export] path = "../hub/designs/m/design.json"` exported into the hub on its first --call write: "export written to …/hub/designs/m/design.json (created; named by .reflow2.toml [export] path)". So the 2026-10-06 fix (chg:a-projects-export-path-is-recorded-once-and-read-by-everything-2026-10-06) covers a member whose export lives in another repo. It is not in 0.80.0, which the reporter runs. In a repo the person does not own, the .reflow2.toml must stay untracked (.git/info/exclude). The served hub skill does not mention [export] at all, so a member is not told to set it.
